summary:
Space Explorer Simulator is an interactive space exploration game where you can travel through the Solar System, visit all eight planets, explore their moons, discover asteroids and learn about the universe using real NASA information.

 Welcome to Space Explorer Simulator

Become a space explorer and travel across the Solar System in your own spaceship. Visit every planet, discover amazing landscapes, explore moons and experience space.

Main Features

- Explore all 8 planets.
- Travel freely through space.
- Land on planetary surfaces.
- Explore each planet's moons.
- Discover Saturn's rings.
- Visit asteroid belts.
- Learn scientific facts about planets.
- Explore realistic environments based on NASA images and discoveries.
- Navigate using a 3D Solar System map.

Official NASA Information and Sources

Your mission is to explore all eight planets, discover their secrets and learn about the Solar System through an immersive 3D experience based on real NASA scientific information.
details: Our project offers a very interesting and fun journey into space. Whenever you tap on the name of a planet, you will be taken closer to it, and you will be provided with information sourced from NASA.
